# closett

Closes Tera Term.

```ttl
closett
```

## Remarks

Closes Tera Term and enters the unlinked state.
In the unlinked state, the "connect" command can open a new Tera Term window and link MACRO to it.

This command always disables the warning on TCP/IP disconnection regardless of [ConfirmDisconnect](https://teratermproject.github.io/manual/5/en/html/setup/teraterm-com.html#confirm) configuration.

## Example

```ttl
messagebox 'foo' 'val'
closett
end
```
